title: Linear tangency conjecture for pairwise intersecting bi-infinite x-monotone curves
statement: Let $k$ be a fixed positive integer, and let a family consist of $n$ pairwise intersecting bi-infinite $x$-monotone curves such that any two curves intersect at most $k$ times. **Linear tangency conjecture.** The family admits $O_k(n)$ tangencies. This would extend the corresponding linear bound for $1$-intersecting curves to every fixed intersection parameter $k$; the statement is presented as a suggested generalization and its resolution is not specified here.
source_name: Eyal Ackerman and Balázs Keszegh, “On the maximum number of tangencies among 1-intersecting curves”, arXiv:2603.11885 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11885

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of March 2026).
